title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）, 2026-07-13
quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇
what_it_establishes: 汇发〔2020〕14号 Art. 59: a foreign individual buying FX against income earned in China needs ID plus source-of-funds material including tax evidence.

title: 2024年经常项目外汇政策问答案例（九）, 2024-06-21
quote: 持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。
what_it_establishes: Only a foreign individual holding the PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID card gets the annual convenience amount for buying FX.

title: 2022年外汇业务政策释疑（八）, 2022-09-29
quote: 个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度便利化额度管理，便利化额度分别为每人每年等值5万美元 … 年度便利化额度不是个人每年购汇或者结汇的限额，只是超过等值5万美元的购汇或结汇不能仅凭本人有效身份证件办理。
what_it_establishes: The USD 50,000 is a convenience amount, not a ceiling: above it the same conversion is done with documents. The rule appends 境内个人 (domestic individual) to the buying side.

title: 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》 full text (annex to 汇发〔2020〕14号)
quote: 第六十五条 境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外：（一）外汇账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理；（二）持外币现钞汇出，当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理。 第六十二条 … 关注期限为列入“关注名单”的当年及之后连续 2 年。
what_it_establishes: Art. 65: a foreign individual's FX-account remittance needs only valid ID, with no amount threshold. Art. 62: watch-list period is the year of listing plus two.

title: 中国人民银行公告[2004]第16号 —《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》
quote: 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出。首次可汇出金额不得超过全部申请转移财产的一半；自首次汇出满一年后，可汇出不超过剩余财产的一半 … 全部申请转移财产在等值人民币20万元以下（含20万元）的，经批准后可一次性汇出。
what_it_establishes: The dedicated route for an emigrant's own pre-departure property and for an inheritance; one application, staged remittance in the original rule.

title: （已修改）汇发〔2014〕2号 关于进一步改进和调整资本项目外汇管理政策的通知
quote: 六、简化个人财产转移售付汇管理 …（二）取消移民财产转移分次汇出的要求。申请人向原户籍所在地外汇局办理移民财产转移核准手续后，银行可在核准件审批额度内一次或分次汇出相关资金。
what_it_establishes: Art. 6(2) removed the staging requirement: after approval the bank may remit once or in instalments. Art. 6(1) also removed the RMB 500,000 referral to SAFE headquarters.

title: 个人财产转移购付汇业务问答（七）, 2026-03-19
quote: 根据《…资本项目外汇业务指引（2024年版）》（汇发〔2024〕12号）6.4，移民财产转移由移民原户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。继承财产转移由被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。
what_it_establishes: Where the two property-transfer routes are approved: the former hukou for emigrant transfer, the decedent's hukou for inheritance.

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（10）, 2026-09-17
quote: 境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）…的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。
what_it_establishes: Change-back route: 24-month validity of the original exchange slip; USD 500 a day without one.

title: 2025年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（八）, 2025-06-13
quote: 外汇局对借用他人便利化额度及其他方式规避便利化额度及真实性管理的个人，列入“关注名单”管理
what_it_establishes: Borrowing another person's convenience amount puts you on the watch list.

title: 汇发〔2017〕29号 关于规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易的通知
quote: 个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币。超过年度额度的，本年及次年将被暂停持境内银行卡在境外提取现金。… 人民币卡管理维持每卡每日不得超过等值1万元人民币
what_it_establishes: ATM ceiling: RMB 10,000 per card per day, RMB 100,000 per person per year; breach suspends overseas cash withdrawals for the year and the next.

title: 外汇知识问答：请问每次可带外币出境的限额是多少？, 2019-05-21
quote: 个人携带外币现钞金额在5000美元（含）以下的，海关直接放行；5000美元以上10000美元（含）以下的，应向银行申领《携带外汇出境许可证》；10000美元以上的，应向外汇局申领…但原则上…不得携带10000美元以上的外币现钞出境。
what_it_establishes: Cash carrying: USD 5,000 free, 5,000-10,000 with a bank permit, above 10,000 in principle not allowed.

title: 关于个人网上办理外币兑换业务的温馨提示, 2020-03-04
quote: 个人在银行办理结售汇业务…应通过银行等正规渠道办理，不得通过非法渠道买卖外汇
what_it_establishes: Only banks and licensed outlets may convert currency; private FX trading is not a lawful channel.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (国务院令第532号)
quote: 第五条 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。 第三十九条 …处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。 第四十五条 私自买卖外汇…处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。 第五十二条（二）境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人
what_it_establishes: No restriction on current international payments and transfers; the penalty ladder for evading, buying FX with false documents and private FX trading; and the Regulation's own definition of 境内个人.

title: 个人外汇管理办法 (中国人民银行令〔2006〕第3号)
quote: 第十二条 …单笔或当日累计汇出在规定金额以上的，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明等材料在银行办理。 第十三条 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目项下合法人民币收入，可以凭本人有效身份证件及相关证明材料在银行办理购汇及汇出。 第三十七条（二）境外个人是指持护照…的外国公民
what_it_establishes: The Measures classify by ID document: a passport holder is a 境外个人. Art. 13 permits buying FX and remitting against lawful current-account income.

title: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局公告2013年第40号 (tax filing for outbound payments)
quote: 一、境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上…均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案 … 六、…主管税务机关无须当场进行纳税事项审核，应编制《备案表》流水号，在《备案表》上盖章
what_it_establishes: The 对外支付税务备案 is a filing, not a charge: the tax office issues the form without auditing the tax on the spot. It is triggered above USD 50,000 per payment in the listed categories.

title: 2021年服务贸易外汇管理问题解答（四）, 2021-11-02
quote: 境外个人将其从境内取得的服务贸易、收益和经常转移项下的人民币收入购汇汇出的，可凭本人身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理；税务凭证包括《服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案表》或完税证明或免税证明。
what_it_establishes: What counts as tax evidence: the filing form, a tax payment certificate, or an exemption certificate.

title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (2018 amendment)
quote: 第三条（三）利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。 第四条 lists the exempt categories (no inheritance clause); 第十八条 leaves savings-deposit interest to the State Council.
what_it_establishes: The 20% flat rate on dividends, interest, rent, property gains and incidental income; 3%-45% progressive on wages and service income; nine taxable categories with no inheritance category.

issuer: Ministry of Finance / State Taxation Administration
title: 财税〔2008〕132号 关于储蓄存款利息所得有关个人所得税政策的通知
quote: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税 … 储蓄存款在2008年10月9日后（含10月9日）孳生的利息所得，暂免征收个人所得税。
what_it_establishes: Interest on a savings deposit accrued from 9 October 2008 is exempt from individual income tax.

issuer: People's Bank of China et al.
title: 银发〔2026〕42号 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币等相关风险的通知, 2026-02-06
quote: 在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务…属于非法金融活动，一律严格禁止 … 本通知自发布之日起施行。…《…》（银发〔2021〕237号）同时废止。
what_it_establishes: Converting RMB into crypto or stablecoins inside mainland China is prohibited by the notice in force from 2026-02-06, which repealed the 2021 notice.

title: 个人金融服务收费 — 中银财互通 note / 外币现钞
quote: 中行内跨省、省内异地外币转账 每笔转账金额的1‰，最高200元/笔。
what_it_establishes: Domestic transfers between BOC foreign-currency accounts: 0.1% of the amount, max RMB 200.

title: 深化跨境投融资外汇管理便利化政策操作指引 (operating guide to 汇发〔2025〕43号), §8
quote: §8 lists the documents for a personal property-transfer remittance, including the registered property contract and the tax certificate, and caps the remittance at the sale price less the taxes of that sale.
what_it_establishes: The document list and the cap for the home-sale route. Read as an excerpt (section 8 only); flag U17 remains open.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions (2023 ed.)
quote: §988(c)(1)(C)(i) the disposition of any nonfunctional currency shall be treated as a section 988 transaction … §988(e)(2) The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200. §988(e)(3) 'personal transaction' … shall not include any transaction to the extent that expenses properly allocable to such transaction meet the requirements of section 162 … or section 212.
what_it_establishes: Selling RMB is a §988 transaction. The personal-transaction relief only covers USD 200 or less of gain; above that the whole gain is ordinary income.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
quote: China | Yuan | 2025 7.129 | 2024 7.189 | 2023 7.075 | 2022 6.730 | 2021 6.452. The IRS has no official exchange rate; it generally accepts any posted rate used consistently.
what_it_establishes: The yearly average rate used to size a currency gain, and the IRS statement that it publishes no official rate.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
quote: Form 8938: Specified individuals living in the US … more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $75,000 at any time during the year … Penalties: Up to $10,000 for failure to disclose and an additional $10,000 for each 30 days of non-filing after IRS notice … potential maximum penalty of $60,000. FBAR: aggregate value … exceeds $10,000 at any time during the calendar year.
what_it_establishes: FBAR threshold USD 10,000 on the aggregate; Form 8938 thresholds by filing status and residence; the USD 60,000 Form 8938 penalty ceiling.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table
quote: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation … 10,000 -> 16,536. 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) Willful Violation … 100,000 -> 165,353. Column heading: Maximum penalty amount … for penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025.
what_it_establishes: The inflation-adjusted FBAR ceilings in force for assessments on or after 2025-01-17.

title: Report Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR page)
quote: A United States person must file an FBAR to report a financial interest in or signature authority over at least one financial account located outside of the United States if the aggregate value of all foreign financial accounts exceeds $10,000 at any time during the calendar year.
what_it_establishes: Who must file an FBAR, and the calendar-year maximum-value basis.

title: 31 U.S.C. § 5321 — Civil penalties (2023 ed.)
quote: §5321(a)(5)(C)(i) the maximum penalty … shall be increased to the greater of— (I) $100,000, or (II) 50 percent of the amount determined under subparagraph (D) … §5321(a)(5)(D)(ii) … the balance in the account at the time of the violation.
what_it_establishes: The statutory willful alternative: the greater of USD 100,000 (as adjusted) or 50% of the account balance at the time of the violation.

title: Gifts from foreign person (Form 3520, Part IV)
quote: For gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate, you are required to report … only if the aggregate amount received … exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year. … For purported gifts from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships … exceeds $20,116 for 2025, and $20,573 for 2026.
what_it_establishes: A foreign gift or bequest is not income to the recipient; the USD 100,000 threshold triggers Form 3520 reporting. USD 20,573 is the 2026 threshold for gifts from foreign corporations and partnerships.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 6039F — Notice of large gifts received from foreign persons
quote: §6039F(c) … an amount equal to 5 percent of the amount of such foreign gift for each month for which the failure continues (not to exceed 25 percent in the aggregate).
what_it_establishes: The Form 3520 penalty: 5% of the gift per month, capped at 25%.

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
quote: There is no limit on the amount of money that may be brought into or taken out of the United States. However, if you transport or cause to be transported … more than $10,000 in monetary instruments on any occasion into or out of the United States … you must file a report (FinCEN 105).
what_it_establishes: No limit on importing cash; more than USD 10,000 must be reported on FinCEN Form 105 on entry.

title: 2024年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（三）, 2024-02-29
quote: 第六十四条 境内个人外汇汇出境外用于经常项目支出 … 外汇账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料办理。
what_it_establishes: Art. 64 shows that the same threshold logic (ID alone up to USD 50,000, documents above) is applied on the domestic-individual side of the same article set.
